_comment: Map 2, marble: the Bentham drawing in the Temple of Time's stone, one closed rotunda authored in WORLD coordinates -- instance at identity. The ground floor at y -1.0 is covered in marble spikes; the running lane is a gallery walkway slab r 46.7..59.55 at y 23.0 (Map 1's ring height) with its inner edge OPEN over a 24 m drop to the spikes; the wall is seven tiers of 64 arched cells (448 cells, 4.0 x 5.5 m mouths, 3.0 m deep, five iron bars over every arch), three tiers below the walkway and four above, a pilaster on every pier, a cornice on every tier, a Greek-key frieze at 55.0..56.8, a great cornice, and a solid coffered dome from y 57.8 to the crown at 84.8 -- no oculus. ONE material: the painted 256 px atlas (USE_TEXTURE_FILES swaps in textures/marble_albedo.png). MarbleCollision is the purpose-built collider shipped as a `-colonly` node: the floor, the slab (top, inner face, underside), the plain wall face, the dome. The spikes and bars are NOT colliders -- the scene's kill cylinder kills a body before it lands. Godot turns the collider into a StaticBody3D + ConcavePolygonShape3D and drops its mesh, so `surfaces` counts only what is drawn. The stone is 68k triangles: seven tiers of barred cells is what the drawing costs, in map_base's class (71k).
